periocular_spatial_geometry.dominant_axis_orientation: Approximately 45-degree downward tilt relative to the horizontal facial axis, oriented toward the rostrum.
periocular_spatial_geometry.aspect_ratio_factor: Oval morphology with a horizontal length approximately 1.5 times the vertical height.
periocular_spatial_geometry.inferior_centroid_shift: Notable downward tapering on the medial-inferior edge creating an asymmetrical teardrop effect.

cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.inter_bounding_box_euclidean_distance: Significant white cranial gap, estimated at twice the width of a single ear base.
cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.apex_contour_smoothness: Smooth, semicircular convex curvature on the superior boundary.

other_distinctive_markers: Highly visible, high-contrast white claws on both the forelimb and hindlimb.
